composing_text: The two Army divisions Harmon designated for the corps (Miller, chapter IX). Marine ground forces already on the island are described in the same chapter; the Marine division headquarters landed two days later.
source_locator: R2225: ch. IX; R2227: Part VI, ch. 9
notes: General Harmon activated or designated the Guadalcanal-Tulagi command as XIV Corps on 2 January 1943; Patch became corps commander and Brigadier General Sebree succeeded him at Americal (Miller, ch. IX; Hough, Ludwig and Shaw, Part VI, ch. 9; CMH chronology of 2 January). Confidence 0.7. This claim file promotes the existing placeholder US-COR-014C; no new corps id was invented.
